title: Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards: government response to report
description: The government's response to the Committee's 2020 report Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards
summary: The government has responded to a report on Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards after it was published in 2020. The response outlines their approach to addressing the recommendations made in the report.

title: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) in education
description: The Department for Education’s (DfE) position on the use of generative AI in the education sector.
summary: The Department for Education is developing a policy on the use of generative AI in education to address its potential impact and benefits. The policy aims to ensure the responsible use of this technology in the education sector.

title: ​​Ofqual’s approach to regulating the use of artificial intelligence in the qualifications sector​
description: Published in response to a request from the Secretary of State for Education, the Secretary of State for Science, Innovation and Technology, and the Secretary of State for Business and Trade.
summary: This document outlines Ofqual's approach to regulating the use of artificial intelligence in the qualifications sector. It aims to provide guidance in response to a request from the UK government to address the role of AI in exams and qualifications.

title: Report and impact assessment on Copyright and Artificial Intelligence
description: A report and impact assessment on the use of copyright works in the development of artificial intelligence (AI) systems.
summary: This document assesses the impact of using copyrighted works in the development of artificial intelligence systems. It likely discusses the potential consequences for copyright laws and holders.

title: Government response to the House of Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence
description: Government response to the Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence report ‘AI in the UK: No Room for Complacency’.
summary: This document is the Government's response to a report by the House of Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence, highlighting their proposed actions and measures in response to the committee's recommendations. The document is titled 'Government Response to the House of Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence: AI in the UK - No Room for Complacency'.

title: AI and Public Standards – Terms of Reference
description: Terms of Reference and FAQs for the Committee's review into artificial intelligence and public standards.
summary: This document outlines the terms of reference for a committee reviewing how artificial intelligence aligns with public standards. It provides answers to frequently asked questions about this review.

title: CSPL submission to Science and Technology Committee inquiry on Governance of AI
description: CSPL has submitted written evidence to the Science and Technology Committee's inquiry on Governance of Artificial Intelligence.
summary: The CSPL has submitted written evidence to an inquiry on the governance of Artificial Intelligence. This submission will help inform the Science and Technology Committee about the governance of AI.

title: Impact of AI on the regulation of medical products
description: Implementing the Artificial Intelligence (AI) White Paper principles.
summary: This document discusses the potential effects of artificial intelligence on regulations related to medical products, aiming to inform policy decisions. It likely outlines guidance for implementing AI principles in the context of medical product regulation.

title: Defence Artificial Intelligence Strategy
description: Our vision is that, in terms of AI, we will be the world’s most effective, efficient, trusted and influential Defence organisation for our size.
summary: The Defence Artificial Intelligence Strategy aims to make the Defence organisation the most effective, efficient, and trusted when it comes to using artificial intelligence. This vision is achieved by being influential for its size in the global AI landscape.

title: Transport artificial intelligence action plan
description: Sets out how DfT will work with the transport sector to exploit the opportunities from AI while managing potential risks.
summary: The Transport AI Action Plan aims to leverage artificial intelligence in the transport sector while addressing potential risks associated with its use. It outlines how the Department for Transport (DfT) will collaborate with the transport sector to achieve this goal.
